who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane blaze-build under the ladder lead
where: crates/blaze-build (blaze-typeck body + Checked record to blaze-lir)
what: The body form holds no literal values, so `blaze_build::Adts` grew `int_lit`, `int_pat` and `byte_str` (default: none, refused as NoLiteralValue); blaze-typeck's ToyWorld and BodyView accessors are pub(crate), so every consumer's tests rewrite a World and a body buffer by hand; the shared cargo lock held the lane for long stretches behind other lanes' tests.
cost: about half an hour of waiting on the lock; a test World of ~120 lines duplicated from typeck's
cause: the body form and its test helpers were shaped for the checker alone
whys: typeck needs a literal's kind only; a builder needs its value; test worlds were never exported
class: a record shaped for one consumer forces its second consumer to carry a parallel column
prevention: open: a literal-value column in the body form read by blaze-build; export a test World from blaze-typeck's `toy` feature
workaround: Adts::int_lit/int_pat/byte_str in blaze-build; TestWorld in crates/blaze-build/src/tests.rs
